working_tree: uncommitted; SHA-256 identifies this pre-extension snapshot
scope: Installed debug runtime API families versus the bounded native mini-app interface. No full API, OHOS, visual, device, or performance parity claim.

dependency_report.constraint_policy: Exclude (c) constraint-only rows. Follow selected versions after ->. Cache files count only after the coordinate resolves.

status_definitions.verified: The explicitly named check passed for its exact scope and snapshot.
status_definitions.partial: A native contract exists, but the family has gaps or incomplete workflow evidence.
status_definitions.planned: A bounded native extension is recommended. It is not callable at this snapshot.
status_definitions.host_only: Installed or available only to native host code. It is not a generated-code API.
status_definitions.unavailable: No current generated-artifact contract exists. No extension is claimed.
status_definitions.source_verified: Resolved dependency and matching source declaration inspected. This is not rendered workflow verification.
status_definitions.source_verified_workflow_partial: Native source mapping inspected. Earlier workflow evidence is partial, failed, or not family-specific.
status_definitions.not_run_for_this_inventory: This package performed no device, provider, accessibility-service, or visual workflow run.

native_contract.properties: children; style.align/padding/gap; grid.columns; spacer.size

native_contract.limits: 32 KiB UI; 256 structural nodes; depth 8; 1..50 children; grid 1..4 columns; spacer 0..64 dp.

Reject nonfinite, negative, excessive, and unknown dimensions.

evidence_limits: No new rendered workflow, device operation, provider call, physical latency, or physical frame-rate measurement ran.
